description: Fire a conversion from an AGENT-COMMERCE purchase (ACP / AP2) that has no browser or pixel. Pass the settled ACP checkout session or AP2 payment mandate; adscapi maps it to a canonical event and fans it out to every ad platform so the ad that drove the agent gets credit.

payload.description: The settled ACP CheckoutSession or AP2 PaymentMandate object.

protocol.description: Which agent-commerce protocol the payload is from.

name: adscapi_fire_agent_conversion
